$comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for app/redesign/tokens.css. Generated by hand from the Figma DESIGN SYSTEM - BIRDHAUS published team library via the Figma MCP (getLocalVariableCollectionsAsync + getLocalTextStylesAsync). To refresh: re-run that enumeration against the focused DS file, overwrite the values below, then `npm run tokens`. The Figma Variables REST API is Enterprise-gated (this account is Pro), so the pull is a deliberate manual step, not a deploy-time fetch. tokens.css is generated but committed so value changes show as a reviewable diff.
